info.about: Dragon Quest III: The Seeds of Salvation, titled Dragon Warrior III when initially localized to North America, is a 1988 role-playing video game developed by Chunsoft and published by Enix. It is the third installment in the Dragon Quest series and was first released for the Family Computer (Famicom) in Japan and later for the Nintendo Entertainment System (NES) in North America.
info.why: Enix released the Game Boy Color version in North America in July 2001, weeks after the Game Boy Advance launched, so the cartridge run was small.
